answer:
In Ollama version 0.32.10 and later, models that do not set their own `repeat_penalty` default to 1.0, which is considered "off." This change was made to match other engines and speed up speculative decoding. This information is indicated in the release notes:

"Models that don't set a `repeat_penalty` now default to 1.0 (off) instead of 1.1, matching other engines and speeding up speculative decoding; set a per-model parameter if an older model repeats itself."  
[ollama/v0.32.10.md (lines 1-9)](https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.32.10)
